title: CHILD DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATE TEACHER
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Child Development Associate Teacher Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Integrate an understanding of the needs, characteristics, and multiple influences that support optimal development in all areas of development for children from birth to age eight.
Promote partnerships between programs, teachers, families, and communities, applying ethical standards and culturally sensitive professional behavior.
Design, implement, and evaluate developmentally appropriate environments, curriculum, and teacher/child interactions, while applying the skills of observation and assessment.

notes: The heading 'REQUIRED COURSES (16 UNITS)' covers the five 3-unit courses plus the choice of CH DEV 172 (1 unit) or CH DEV 084-1 and CH DEV 084-2 (0.5 each); the 16 is recorded as stated on the main block though it includes the 1-unit option.
The catalog prints 'CH DEV 172 ... OR CH DEV 084-1 AND CH DEV 084-2'; recorded as two option blocks sharing an option_group since the alternative is a pair of courses.
Catalog codes are zero-padded (CH DEV 001, 002, 007, 010); matched to closed-list CH DEV 1, 2, 7, 10. CH DEV 011 and CH DEV 172 are not in the closed list.
Outcome 2 hyphenation 'sen -sitive' across a line break was read as 'sensitive'.
CH DEV 030 (for infant programs) and CH DEV 038 (Title 22 Director) are mentioned as additions, not requirements of this certificate; not placed.

No specific career titles named; text mentions teaching in private preschool or school-age programs and the California Child Development Permit: Associate Teacher level, which were not recorded as careers.
